title: HATCH and MPOLYGON peer, consumer, and field-semantics refresh
mode: deeper and broader research; plan refinement
scope: Cross-check per-path DWG HATCH reference ownership against ODA and independent reader/model implementations
Clarify Autodesk HATCH versus MPOLYGON group-71 field semantics
Reconcile ezdxf association limits and FreeCAD's documented converter/importer boundary
Refine PAR-140 / 7N.4 implementation readiness without promoting support claims

sources.name: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sources.observed: Sections 20.4.75 and 2.13 specify per-path BL group-97 counts, the flattened post-common-entity H handle list, and absolute/relative soft-pointer encodings.
sources.limit: Normative for DWG byte layout; does not establish target existence or consumer recompute behavior.

sources.name: Autodesk HATCH Boundary Path Data
sources.observed: DXF group 97 counts source boundary objects in each path and repeated group 330 values reference those objects.
sources.limit: DXF documentation; does not validate that handles resolve or that a CAD application maintains associativity.

sources.name: Autodesk AutoCAD 2014 DXF reference
sources.observed: The shared HATCH/MPOLYGON field table assigns group 71 to associativity for HATCH but solid-fill for MPOLYGON; the common path data still includes group 97 and group 330 references.
sources.limit: Versioned DXF reference; local tests still need to verify the exact supported writer behavior.

sources.name: LibreDWG public HATCH model and NEWS
sources.observed: The public Dwg_HATCH_Path model has per-path count/list fields. The 0.14 release history records an associative-HATCH handle-index reset-per-path bug fix, plus path-derived-state and rational spline-weight fixes.
sources.limit: Independent model and implementation history only; not normative authority, a local reproduction, or current executable qualification. NEWS master is mutable.

sources.name: ACadSharp DWG object-reader source snapshot
sources.observed: The reader consumes each boundary-object BL count inside the path loop and appends the following soft-pointer handles to that path template before publishing it.
sources.limit: Source inspection only; mutable branch and no ACadSharp executable or package was run.

sources.name: ezdxf associative HATCH tutorial and HATCH reference
sources.observed: ezdxf stores source boundary handle lists but explicitly does not maintain or validate the association against boundary geometry.
sources.limit: Independent DXF model/library guidance, not a native CAD engine or DWG authority.

sources.name: FreeCAD published Draft DXF and DWG route documentation
sources.observed: The archived documentation baseline distinguishes C++ and legacy Python DXF importers, does not list HATCH/MPOLYGON in its explicit importer entity inventories, states that embedded ACIS/SAT solids cannot be read by stock DXF import, and documents DWG conversion through an external converter before DXF import.
sources.limit: Published capability baseline, not runtime evidence for an arbitrary build/backend. Entity-list omission is not proof of rejection; exact consumer claims require a pinned runtime test.

observed: The local neutral model and DXF fields retain per-path references, but the DWG reader and writer previously discarded them; this was already inventoried as PAR-140/7N.4.
MPOLYGON uses shared boundary references but its DXF group-71 semantic is solid-fill rather than HATCH associativity.

The generated PAR-140 ASCII/Binary roundtrip exposed that writeMPolygon lacked the reference resolver/remapper used by HATCH; the writer path has been aligned and is covered by actual target-handle assertions.
Stock FreeCAD documentation is not a positive consumer source for HATCH, MPOLYGON association, or ACIS/AcDs semantics.

implementationReadiness.localSlice: PAR-140/7N.4 generated fast codec slice implemented; follow the separate progress receipt for exact changed files and validation.
implementationReadiness.remainingComposition: Keep graph-closure failure behavior, geometric path agreement, and native associative edit/recompute as separate gates.
implementationReadiness.mpolygon: Assert group-97/330 path references separately from group-71 solid-fill; do not treat group 71 as HATCH associativity.
implementationReadiness.freecad: Pinned converter-to-DXF-to-selected-importer route only; HATCH/MPOLYGON consumption is runtime-pending and stock ACIS/3D solid consumption is unsupported by the published baseline.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No external drawing downloaded or committed. Generated controls are temporary and removed.
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: One strict focused target build, selector, and owning CTest per local slice; full suites remain scheduled composed checkpoints.
